say:1:1029106001:1.text: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...
say:1:1029106001:1.source_cn: 我刚好在想你的事情呢。难道这就是所谓的“宿命的相逢”？...
say:1:1029106001:1.male: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...
say:1:1029106001:1.female: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...

choice_prompt:2:1029106001.text: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...
choice_prompt:2:1029106001.source_cn: 我刚好在想你的事情呢。难道这就是所谓的“宿命的相逢”？——等等！你们身边这个女孩子，看起来好像有点眼熟啊……
choice_prompt:2:1029106001.male: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...
choice_prompt:2:1029106001.female: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...

say:4:1029106003:2.text: That weird manner of speaking... it IS you! Dora! Where have you been?
say:4:1029106003:2.source_cn: 这奇奇怪怪的说话方式……是你！朵拉！她怎么会和你们在一起？

say:6:1029106004:1.text: So her name's Dora, eh? What a surprisingly normal name!
say:6:1029106004:1.source_cn: 原来这个女孩叫朵拉呀，意外的个正常名字呢！

say:8:1029106005:1.text: Thou liest! That name be not mine! I am of the abyss, and my true name resounds throughout the whole world!
say:8:1029106005:1.source_cn: 汝等不要妄言，吾名并非如此！吾乃深渊之眷属，吾名响彻大地！

say:9:1029106006:1.text: Whole world? Maybe throughout the whole of Holistone, seeing as everyone knows you're the biggest troublemaker.
say:9:1029106006:1.source_cn: 什么响彻大地，响彻整个圣石镇还差不多，大家都知道你最能...

say:11:1029106008:1.text: Alright, don't deny it. I know you're Dora. So, what's she been up to this time?
say:11:1029106008:1.source_cn: 行了行了，别抵赖了，我知道你就是朵拉。所以她这次又惹上...

choice_prompt:12:1029106008.text: Alright, don't deny it. I know you're Dora. So, what's she been up to this time?
choice_prompt:12:1029106008.source_cn: 行了行了，别抵赖了，我知道你就是朵拉。所以她这次又惹上什么事了？

say:13:1029106009:1.text: The Sun Temple? You went by yourself to such a dangerous place? That takes some guts!
say:13:1029106009:1.source_cn: 日神殿？你竟然一个人去了那么危险的地方？真是长本事了啊！

say:14:1029106011:1.text: It's lucky you met Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, otherwise I reckon you would've been ripped apart by a Hypofiend!
say:14:1029106011:1.male: It's lucky you met Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, otherwise I reckon you would've been ripped apart by a Hypofiend!
say:14:1029106011:1.female: It's lucky you met Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, otherwise I reckon you would've been ripped apart by a Hypofiend!

say:15:1029106012:1.text: I can't just overlook such an incident. Come, we're going to talk to your parents about it.
say:15:1029106012:1.source_cn: 这事我可不能当没听到。走，跟我一起去和你父母好好聊聊。

say:16:1029106013:1.text: No, please! You can't tell them!

say:18:1029106014:1.text: Oh, so she can talk normally, after all...

say:20:1029106015:1.text: You were just talking weirdly like that on purpose!
say:20:1029106015:1.source_cn: 原来你之前说的那些奇怪句子，都是故意的啊！

say:21:1029106016:1.text: Please, Mr. Valen! Blame me all you want; just don't tell my parents... I'll be in so much trouble!
say:21:1029106016:1.source_cn: 求你了维伦先生，你要怎么责怪我都行，只要别告诉爸爸妈妈...

say:22:1029106017:1.text: They might ground me for the rest of my life. I'd be locked in the attic forever!
say:22:1029106017:1.source_cn: 说不定还会被禁足，往后余生都只能被关在家里的小阁楼，永...

say:23:1029106018:1.text: Not gonna happen. This is a big deal. You could have been killed, and your parents need to know.
say:23:1029106018:1.source_cn: 不可能，这可不是什么小事。但凡当时有什么意外，你就可能...

say:24:1029106019:1.text: Your parents aren't totally heartless, either. You won't be locked in the attic forever. Maybe a week at most.
say:24:1029106019:1.source_cn: 另外你父母也不是这么不通情理的人，不会把你永远关在阁楼...

say:25:1029106020:1.text: A w-week?! Isn't that bad enough?! Do you KNOW how long a week is or how terrible being grounded for that long would be? No! You have no idea!
say:25:1029106020:1.source_cn: 一、一周！这还不够可怕吗！你知道一周有多久吗，你知道禁...

say:27:1029106021:2.text: And thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We're lucky you were there!
say:27:1029106021:2.male: And thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We're lucky you were there!
say:27:1029106021:2.female: And thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We're lucky you were there!

say:28:1029106022:1.source_cn: 维伦完全无视了朵拉的哀嚎呢……

say:29:1029106023:1.text: Well, I should be getting this little troublemaker back. We should grab a meal when you have time!
say:29:1029106023:1.source_cn: 那么，这个麻烦小孩我就先带走了。下次有空再一起吃饭啊！

say:31:1029106024:1.text: Wow! Dora was struggling so hard, but Valen just hauled her away!
say:31:1029106024:1.source_cn: 呜哇！朵拉还想要挣扎，直接被维伦拎走了呢！

choice:12:0:1.text: She ran off to the Sun Temple.
choice:12:0:1.male: She ran off to the Sun Temple.
choice:12:0:1.female: She ran off to the Sun Temple.

say:35:1029106010:1.text: Sneaking off to investigate the Hypogean Rift... Do you have a death wish?
say:35:1029106010:1.source_cn: 偷偷调查恶魔裂隙……你不想活啦？
